name: figma-edit-mcp
description: Read, create, and modify Figma designs programmatically via MCP, empowering AI to execute Figma changes safer, cleaner, and faster.
long_description:
Connect AI assistants to Figma via Model Context Protocol to read designs, create and modify elements, and manage design systems programmatically.

This plugin empowers your AI assistant to become an active design co-pilot, executing updates and modifications Safer, Cleaner, and Faster than manual entry. By offloading repetitive, error-prone manual operations to automated systems, designers are freed to focus entirely on creative decision-making and product strategy.

### Core Principles

* **🛡️ Safer**: The server enforces robust programmatic checks and validations that exceed the Figma Desktop app's default protections. For instance, it prevents deleting variables currently in use to avoid dangling references. By validating all writes against a locked editable scope and strict name checks before execution, it protects files from human error and AI hallucinations.

* **✨ Cleaner**: System-driven, programmatic operations guarantee that no layers, text nodes, or components are skipped or forgotten during complex updates. Every design file stays consistent and conforms exactly to your design system.

* **⚡ Faster**: Bulk edits like propagating instance overrides, batch-updating copy, or restructuring auto-layout frames are handled via high-performance APIs. Hours of tedious, click-heavy manual work are completed in seconds.

### How it Works (Prerequisites)
This server runs locally on your machine. To operate, it requires:
1. The Figma Desktop App to be open.
2. The `Figma Edit` plugin to be active on the file you want to modify (listening on local port `3845`).

host.title: WebSocket Host
host.description: Host the MCP server uses to reach the Figma plugin

port.title: WebSocket Port
port.description: Port the MCP server uses to reach the Figma plugin

tools.name: page.info
tools.description: List the document's pages; no args → all pages (no children), or pass `pageIds` → those pages with their top-level children. Batch ≤25 ids/call.

tools.name: node.info
tools.description: Read one or more nodes — recursive subtree traversal with `fields` selection, `filter`, and `maxDepth`. Returns only requested fields (incl. resolved `boundVariables`/`explicitVariableModes`). The workhorse read; start here before any write.

tools.name: node.transform
tools.description: Move and/or resize a node by setting absolute `x`/`y`/`width`/`height` (any subset).

tools.name: node.rename
tools.description: Rename a node (sets `name` to an exact value).

tools.name: node.delete
tools.description: Delete one or more nodes in a single batched, per-item-validated call. No API undo.

tools.name: node.clone
tools.description: Duplicate an existing node, optionally at a new `x`/`y`. Produces a new node id.

tools.name: node.select
tools.description: Set the canvas selection to one or more nodes and focus them in the viewport.

tools.name: node.group
tools.description: Wrap multiple nodes in a new group node.

tools.name: node.ungroup
tools.description: Dissolve a group, promoting its children to the parent. Removes the group container.

tools.name: node.flatten
tools.description: Flatten a node and its children into a single vector. Lossy — original structure is not recoverable.

tools.name: node.insert_child
tools.description: Reparent a node under a new parent at an optional `index`.

tools.name: node.set_auto_layout
tools.description: Configure a frame's auto-layout (mode, padding, spacing, alignment, sizing) in one unified setter.

tools.name: node.set_fill
tools.description: Set a node's fill to a literal RGBA color. Use `node.apply_style` to link a shared paint style, or `node.bind_variable` to bind a color token.

tools.name: node.set_stroke
tools.description: Set a node's stroke color and weight; supports uniform or per-side weights.

tools.name: node.set_corner_radius
tools.description: Set a node's corner radius — uniform or per-corner.

tools.name: node.set_effects
tools.description: Set a node's effect array (shadows, blurs). Use `node.apply_style` to link a shared effect style instead.

tools.name: node.apply_style
tools.description: Link a node to a shared library style (paint/text/effect/grid) by `styleId`. Use the raw `node.set_*` setters for ad-hoc values not backed by a style.

tools.name: node.bind_variable
tools.description: Bind a variable to a node property, or set an explicit variable mode. Use instead of a literal `node.set_*` when the value should track a design token.

tools.name: node.export_visual
tools.description: Render a node to an image (PNG/JPG/SVG/PDF) at a given scale. Read-only; the canonical way to visually verify edits.

tools.name: create.shape
tools.description: Create a rectangle, ellipse, polygon, or star via `type`, with position/size and optional `fillColor`/`strokeColor`. Shape-specific params (`arcData`; `pointCount`/`innerRadius`) validated by `type`. `pointCount` = sides (polygon) or points (star), native count — no even-parity rule.

tools.name: create.frame
tools.description: Create a frame (container) with optional fill/stroke and full auto-layout configuration.

tools.name: create.text
tools.description: Create a text node with content and optional font size/weight/color.

tools.name: create.svg
tools.description: Create a node from an SVG markup string.

tools.name: create.component
tools.description: Convert an existing frame into a main component.

tools.name: create.instance
tools.description: Instantiate a component (by `componentKey` or `componentId`) at a position.

tools.name: create.component_set
tools.description: Combine components into a component set (variants) with property definitions.

tools.name: create.connection
tools.description: Create connector lines between nodes, or set/check the default connector template. Pass `connectorId` to set a default, `connections` to draw lines, or nothing to check the current default.

tools.name: style.list
tools.description: List all local styles (paint/text/effect/grid) in the document.

tools.name: style.manage
tools.description: Create a named style (paint/text/effect/grid), or update an existing one when `styleId` is given.

tools.name: style.delete
tools.description: Delete a local style by id. Detaches consumers — they keep their resolved values and lose only the style link.

tools.name: text.set_content
tools.description: Set the text of one or more text nodes in a single batched, per-item-validated call.

tools.name: text.set_style
tools.description: Set any combination of typography properties (font, size, weight, spacing, decoration, …) on a text node.

tools.name: component.list
tools.description: List components in the document, with filtering and scope options.

tools.name: component.manage_property
tools.description: Add or edit a component-property definition (BOOLEAN/TEXT/INSTANCE_SWAP) on a main component or variant set. Deleting is `component.delete_property`.

tools.name: component.delete_property
tools.description: Remove a component-property definition from a main component or variant set; propagates to every instance.

tools.name: instance.set_property
tools.description: Set one property on an instance — boolean toggle, text override, instance swap, or variant selection.

tools.name: instance.get_overrides
tools.description: Read the override properties from a source instance, to later apply them to other instances.

tools.name: instance.set_overrides
tools.description: Apply previously-read overrides to target instances; targets are swapped to the source component and all overrides applied.

tools.name: variable.list
tools.description: List local variables/collections, or detailed info for specific variable ids; optionally scan for consumers.

tools.name: variable.manage
tools.description: Create collections and variables and set their values/aliases (create/update router).

tools.name: variable.delete
tools.description: Delete specific variables or an entire collection. Runs a full-document consumer check first and rejects the whole operation if any target is still in use.

tools.name: annotation.list
tools.description: Read the native annotations on a node (and subtree); optionally include the file's annotation categories.

tools.name: annotation.set
tools.description: Create or update native annotations on one or more nodes in a batched call (per item: `annotationId` present = update, absent = create).

tools.name: reaction.list
tools.description: Read prototype reactions from one or more nodes. Process the output with the `reaction_to_connector_strategy` prompt to build `create.connection` parameters.

tools.name: reaction.update
tools.description: Replace a node's prototype reactions with a full new reactions array (read first via `reaction.list`).

tools.name: channel.join
tools.description: Join a plugin channel to establish the live connection to the Figma document.
